title: Week of Aug 10–16
subtitle: Bridge week — back from the road trip, re-regulate, run decent miles, lift moderate. Big-4 retest now starts Aug 17. Sat/Sun short — Maine cabin weekend.
goals: Block 3 is officially pushed one week — Big-4 retest starts Mon Aug 17. The road trip (Aug 8–11, unlogged, gas-station-fueled) extended the deload by four days; that costs nothing and probably helped. This week's only job is getting the body reregulated: normal sleep times, water, protein at every meal, training that feels good rather than tests anything.

Lifts Wed/Fri are moderate re-entry work — roughly 90% of your Block 2 tops, crisp bar speed, 2–3 in reserve everywhere. You're priming the pattern after 4 days off, not chasing anything. The chasing starts next week.
Mileage ~13: Wed 2 (post-lift), Thu 5 easy, Fri 1.5 (post-lift), Sat ~2.5 at the cabin, Sun 2. All easy — no quality day this week; the legs re-learn rhythm first, speed returns with the block.

Sat + Sun = Maine cabin, deliberately short: a little jog and a quick calisthenics hit each day, ~25–30 min total, then enjoy the weekend. No pull-up benchmark (assuming no bar in the woods) — it returns Sat Aug 22, fresh, inside the retest block.

Food: maintenance starts NOW, not next week — the deficit ended with Block 2. Eat to the SMART goal at deficit 0 and fuel the retest block. Expect the scale to read noisy/high for a few days after road food (sodium + glycogen, not fat) — do not react, do not compensate-cut. 7-day MA only, and even that gets a free pass until ~Friday.

The 189.9-by-Aug-14 target is retired — it belonged to the deficit phase that's over. The plan says maintenance 189–191 through the retest block and the waist is the arbiter. Nothing about the road trip changed the long-term math.
review: Nothing logged since Fri Aug 7 — by design. The deload week closed clean (you kept everything light like it asked), then the road trip took Sat–Tue. Four days of driving, friends, and mediocre food after a deload week is not a setback; it's the most rested you've been since June. Block 2 stays banked: Front Squat 145, Incline 155, Push Press 145, Paused DL 225, first 20+ mi week of the rebuild, pull-up benchmark 18. This week bridges back to structure, and Monday the Big-4 retest starts with a calibration week — squat, bench, deadlift, OHP, ramping to top sets at ~2 RIR to set the block's baselines.

days.name: Road Trip — Travel Day

days.name: Back to Boston — Travel Day
days.desc: Drive home, unpack, real dinner, real bedtime. Re-regulation starts with tonight's sleep, not tomorrow's workout.

days.name: Upper — Re-entry

1 easy set of band pull-aparts or light rows — blood in the upper back

items.note: Ramp 95/125/140 — ~90% of your 155 top. First bar work in 5 days: expect the first set to feel weird and the last to feel great. 2–3 in reserve, UNSPOTTED rules as always.
items.focus: Shoulder blades pinched, bar to upper chest, fast off the chest.

items.note: Ramp 95/115/130 — under your 145. Re-find the dip-drive timing before the block switches you back to strict OHP next week.
items.focus: Dip shallow and vertical, drive through, solid overhead lockout.

items.note: 140 — one step under your 150 top. Squeeze every rep, no yanking.
items.focus: Chest glued to the pad, pull to the lower ribs, squeeze.
Lead with the elbows, full stretch at the top.
Rotate through the core, not just the arms.
Lower back pressed down, ribs tucked.

run.title: Easy Finishing Jog — 2 mi

hr.note: Post-lift HR runs hot — cue effort, not the number.

run.title: Easy Run — 5 mi, strict Z2
run.detail: The week's main run. Boringly easy on purpose — after 4 days off, HR may sit lower than usual at the same pace; enjoy that, don't spend it. Optional: 4×20s relaxed strides at the very end if the legs feel like moving. Log your entered miles, not the watch.

hr.note: If HR drifts over 150 at easy pace, that's the road trip talking — slow down, it'll be gone by next week.

strength.focus: Full depth, chest up — greasing the pattern for Monday's back squat.
Drive through heels, squeeze hard at the top.
Slow, opposite arm/leg, hips stay level.

items.note: 115/130 — well under your 145. Just re-greasing the squat pattern for Monday's back squat calibration. Elbows high, bar speed.
items.focus: Elbows up, upright torso, brace before every descent.
Control the descent, press up and slightly together.

items.note: 3×7, 2–3 in reserve — submax as always on Friday. The max benchmark returns Sat Aug 22.
items.focus: Full hang to chin over the bar, no kipping.
Brace tall, don't lean toward the weight.
